patch.sql:
select
    distinct o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: The unique_stg_orders_order_key test failed with 300 duplicate rows. raw.orders contains duplicate order_key values (e.g., order_key 2979 appears twice) but the duplicate rows are identical across all columns. This indicates a batch was delivered twice. Deduplicating in the staging model resolves the uniqueness violation without losing data.
